subject: POC: global hands-on sprint — schedule & load windows
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Chow <emma.chow@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T22:12:00Z
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Laura / team,

Great to reconnect — excited to get the POC started. Attached is a quick CSV with our preferred windows across time zones (acme_proposed_windows.csv). High-level asks:

- Week of Oct 12–16 for hands-on sessions (three 90-min sessions: prompt review, routing/kv cache walkthrough, and a capped load rehearsal).
- We need at least one session that accommodates APAC engineers (UTC+8 availability 07:00–11:00 local).
- Routing discussion (failover + variant routing) ideally during a lower-latency window for EU participants.

Constraints: our infra team has a maintenance blackout on Oct 14 22:00–02:00 UTC, and procurement needs the signed SOW before any privileged access (we can make that fast if needed).

Can you propose a rotating schedule that hits US morning, EU afternoon, and APAC early morning across the week? Also flag any load-test constraints so we can coordinate pre-warm.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Director of Platform Engineering, Acme Inc.
Attachments: acme_proposed_windows.csv (text/csv)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, Emma Chow <emma.chow@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on windows (US/EU/APAC)

Jordan — thanks for the CSV and the constraints. Proposed approach:

- We run three 90-min hands-on blocks across Oct 12–16. Each day will have a primary block and a follow-up 30-min Q&A for sticky prompt issues.
- Rotation idea:
  * Mon (Oct 12): US-friendly block (US PST morning / EU afternoon) — prompt review + routing primer
  * Wed (Oct 14): EU-primary block with routing deep dive + KV/prefix caching demo (note your blackout window — we will avoid 22:00–02:00 UTC)
  * Fri (Oct 16): APAC-friendly early block (APAC 07:00 local) — load rehearsal and ramp tests

Dev / Priyom, can you confirm whether Fri morning APAC load runs require a reserved GPU pool (Dedicated) or if we can run on hosted infra with pre-warm? Also call out any sequence-length limits we should test.

Jordan — if that rotation works I’ll send calendar invites and a short Ops playbook with expected traffic profile. We can shift Wed -> Tue if you need to avoid maintenance entirely.

– Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.com <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Emma Chow <emma.chow@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T12:30:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on windows (US/EU/APAC)

Laura / Jordan,

Quick technical notes:

- For the Fri APAC load rehearsal: hosted infra can handle a short ramp (up to 300 concurrent token streams) if we enable prefix caching and a 2x batch window. However, sustained throughput beyond ~1.5M tokens/hour will trigger spike throttles — recommend Dedicated if you want sustained high-concurrency for a 60–90 minute load test.
- Sequence-length profile: provide a sample prompt set. We should test two profiles: 1) short prompts (avg 128 tokens) and 2) long chat sessions (avg 1024 tokens). The runtime picks different kernels and affects KV cache pressure.
- Routing/fallback: to demonstrate graceful degradation, we need two model variants available in the pool (baseline and quantized). We can simulate fallback by temporarily pulling baseline out of the pool via a canary route.

I uploaded a draft ops playbook with commands and expected metrics: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1bQx-example-drive-link (redwood-poc-ops-playbook.pdf attached to this thread).

If you want a Dedicated reservation for Friday, we can provision a small 2-GPU pool for a day — pricing and reserve window shown in the playbook.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-poc-ops-playbook.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Chow <emma.chow@acme.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T07:18:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on windows (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks — that all sounds good. Two asks:

1) Could we shift the APAC block one hour earlier (APAC 06:00–07:30 local) so our onsite infra team can attend at the start of their day? It's small but helps our ops folks.
2) Procurement would like an updated SOW and an estimate if we go with the 1-day Dedicated reservation for the load rehearsal. If you can send a short quote we can speed approval.

We confirm the two sequence profiles (128 / 1024) — I'll drop a sample prompt CSV by EOD.

— Jordan

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, Emma Chow <emma.chow@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on windows (updated)

Jordan — thanks, we can shift the APAC block earlier by one hour. Summary & next steps:

- Final rotation (all times shown as UTC for clarity):
  * Mon Oct 12 16:00–17:30 UTC (US-friendly; prompt review + routing primer)
  * Wed Oct 14 13:00–14:30 UTC (EU-primary; routing deep dive + KV cache demo) — avoids your maintenance blackout
  * Fri Oct 16 22:00–23:30 UTC (APAC early local; load rehearsal) -> note this maps to Oct 17 06:00–07:30 APAC+8 local, per your ask
- Load rehearsal: we will provision a 2-GPU Dedicated reservation for the Fri rehearsal. Dev will send a short cost estimate and an attachable SOW addendum by EOD tomorrow.
- Prep: please upload the sample prompt CSV and the two token-distribution profiles to the Drive link. We’ll run short pre-warm tests 48 hours before the rehearsal.
- Calendar: attaching invites (POC-hands-on-week.ics). Please accept so we can lock attendee lists.

If anything else shifts we can rotate Wed/Tue but this schedule should avoid your maintenance window and meet APAC timing.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC-hands-on-week.ics (text/calendar)
